name: issue-flow
description: From request to merge request through an issue that holds the plan and the roadmap that executes it; for large developments, a project roadmap split into issues run in waves, with the work that can be parallelized handed to several agents, each in its own git worktree; several sessions on the same project, each on its own issue, coordinated by a master session; and, before all that, the next steps proposed from the project's documentation. Works on GitLab (glab) and GitHub (gh).

default_branch.title: Target branch
default_branch.description: The branch MR/PRs are merged into. Leave empty to infer it from the repo with git symbolic-ref.

branch_prefix.title: Work branch prefix
branch_prefix.description: An issue's branch is named <prefix><issue number>-<short description from the title>.

roadmap_prefix.title: Roadmap branch prefix
roadmap_prefix.description: The branch of a [ROADMAP] parent — the one big-implement works on — is named <prefix><issue number>-<short description from the title>.

verify_commands.title: Verification commands
verify_commands.description: The commands that must pass before a phase is closed, one per line (e.g. npm test, npm run lint). Empty: inferred from the project.

docs_paths.title: Documentation to keep aligned
docs_paths.description: The documentation files or folders the wrap-up must re-read, one per line (e.g. README.md, docs/).

max_parallel.title: Agents in parallel
max_parallel.description: How many agents can work together under the same assigning agent: children of a wave, phases of a group. Empty: 3. 1 turns parallelism off.

figma_file.title: Project Figma file
figma_file.description: The id of the Figma file to align before the code. Empty: no Figma phase in the roadmaps.
